## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and why the change is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Template compatibility
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Breaking change

## Validation

- [ ] Go tests pass.
- [ ] Frontend lint and build pass when applicable.
- [ ] Docker/installer behavior was tested when applicable.
- [ ] New behavior includes appropriate tests.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for a user-visible change.

## Security and operations

- [ ] No secrets, personal information, private server data, or generated runtime data are included.
- [ ] Permissions and app/worker/engine trust boundaries remain correct.
- [ ] Migration, upgrade, backup, and rollback implications are documented.
- [ ] Breaking behavior is identified with migration or recovery instructions.

## Screenshots or sanitized logs

Include only when useful. Redact credentials, webhook URLs, tokens, public IPs,
player data, and private server files.
